summary: Added optional passkey sign-in language to the Terms, including credential security, recovery, and restrictions against bypassing authentication controls.
Updated the legal definitions, service scope, retention, disclaimer, and liability language to reflect passkey-based authentication and related account-security records.
Expanded the Privacy Policy to explain passkey credential and sign-in data, what authentication details we do not receive, and how credential providers may handle storage or sync.
Clarified how passkey-related records may be used, stored, shared, deleted, or retained alongside existing attendance, OTP, and fallback verification workflows.
Updated Terms and Conditions to align with the finalized legal draft and standardized the Ander Baher trademarked product naming.
Clarified the multi-organisation usage model, governing law wording, and account deletion request path in the Terms.
Expanded the Privacy Policy to cover regularisation evidence, archived business records, and Google-hosted workflow and storage services.
Added disclosure for fallback facial verification through Face++ and aligned operational privacy language with the current attendance and OTP flows.
